description: Cooking covers food safety and nutrition, cooking methods, and planning, cooking and evaluating real meals at home, in camp and on the trail, with attention to allergies, budgets and cleanup.

safety.note: Food handling, stoves, fires and food allergies are safety-sensitive. Cook with appropriate supervision and follow food-safety guidance.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)
Merit Badge Requirement Updates effective January 1, 2025 (scouting.org)

requirements.title: Health and safety
requirements.summary: Cooking hazards and first aid, safe storage and preparation of perishable food, food allergies and reading labels.

requirements.title: Nutrition
requirements.summary: Food groups, limiting oils and sugars, tracking what you eat, reviewing your habits and understanding food labels.

requirements.title: Cooking basics
requirements.summary: Cooking methods, stoves versus fires, timing a meal, and how taste, texture and smell affect eating.

requirements.title: Cooking at home
requirements.summary: Planning menus, making shopping lists, and preparing, timing and evaluating meals at home using several cooking methods.

requirements.title: Camp cooking
requirements.summary: Planning, cooking and evaluating meals and snacks in camp, with safe cleanup and Leave No Trace.

requirements.title: Trail and backpacking meals
requirements.summary: Planning lightweight meals, repackaging food, cooking on a hike and sharing gear.

requirements.title: Careers or hobbies
requirements.summary: One option: exploring cooking careers, or how cooking skills support a hobby or healthy lifestyle.
